questions.question: Describe the normal flora present on skin, mouth and intestine.
questions.solution_html:
• The normal flora of the human body is the collection of microbes that live in a
  • healthy person's body, and is also known as the resident flora or microbiota.(1)
  • Normal microflora of human skin are: (1.5)
  • Staphylococcus aureus
  • Staphylococcus epidermidis
  • Corynebacterium spp
  • Propionibacterium spp
  • Micrococcus spp
  • Normal microflora of human mouth(1)
  • In the mouth, yeast (Candida species) is present. The two protozoans most
  • commonly found in the human mouth are Entamoeba gingivalis and Trichomonas
  • tenax. Even in teeth, several anaerobes such as Provotella spp, Fusobacterium spp
  • Lactobacilli and several anaerobic vibrios are seen.
  • Normal microflora of human intestine(1.5)
  • The normal flora of the intestine, also known as the gut microbiome, is made up of a variety
  • of bacteria, fungi, archaea, and viruses. Give examples.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: of bacteria, fungi, archaea, and viruses. Give examples.
